blockers.title: Real LLM validation
blockers.detail: No OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in env. Mock provider is fully functional; only live-model validation is blocked.
blockers.user_action: Set OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then set DOCGUARD_LLM_PROVIDER=openai|anthropic.

blockers.title: Real GitHub PR end-to-end
blockers.detail: No GITHUB_TOKEN in env. gh CLI is authenticated locally, so opt-in real E2E is possible. Integration + payloads tested against a mocked API.
blockers.user_action: Provide GITHUB_TOKEN (or run inside GitHub Actions) to exercise real PR/comment creation.
